content.text: {"core": "Potential is the open start — the not-yet, before anything has been chosen. In its own position, that openness works on itself: the readiness to begin stays ready, unspent, not yet narrowed into one path. Balanced, the beginning stays a true beginning — nothing forces the first step early, and every direction remains live until one is actually taken.", "sheetLine": "The start stays open; no door is shut before a foot has moved."}
